We've been trying out different looks for the game's screens: the shop, the cards, fights and menus. Out of eight looks, two came out on top.

**Folk Print** uses bold, woodcut-style shapes printed on warm paper, a bit like an old folk-art poster.

{image:1}

**Woodcraft** feels hand-carved: wooden frames, leaf-shaped buttons and little acorns for gold.

{image:2}

Both are in the playable build too, so you can switch between them from the main menu (Look) and see them in a real game.

**What we need from you:** which way do you want to go? One of the two, a mix (tell us what you like in each), or neither, and we'll try some fresh ideas.

**Why it matters:** whatever you pick becomes the starting point for every screen and card from here on.

## Detail

Four judges scored all eight looks on phone readability, the board, cards, combat, how distinct they are, how woodland they feel, and taste. Folk Print scored 226 out of 280 and Woodcraft 225, so they are effectively tied. Field Journal came third with 220.

The [gallery](/design-lab/) shows every look on every screen, with the judges' notes and what each later round changed.
